title: B.A. in Religious Studies
description: Students are required to complete a minimum of 69 units of courses as follows:

sections.title: Faculty Package
text: CURE1110 and any two courses from:

subsections.title: One course from the following selected courses from Area 1
One course from the following selected courses from Area 2
One course from the following selected courses from Area 4
One Capstone course from the following selected courses from Area 5
Nine courses at 2000 or above level from the Religious Studies Areas[a][b]

course_groups.label: Religious Studies Area 1: Approaches to Religious Studies
Religious Studies Area 2: Religious Traditions and Classics
Religious Studies Area 3: Religion, Culture and Society
Religious Studies Area 4: Classical Languages
Religious Studies Area 5: Seminars

subsections.title: Two courses from the Cultural Studies Areas[a][c]

course_groups.label: Cultural Studies Area 1: Cultural Literacy and Practices
Cultural Studies Area 2: Culture, Cities and Politics
Cultural Studies Area 3: Gender, Sexuality and Body
Cultural Studies Area 4: Cultural Industries and Ecology
Cultural Studies Area 5: Film & Media Studies and Practices

subsections.title: Concentrations
text: Students may choose to declare a concentration by taking the following elective courses [a] in place of 3 “Elective Courses” above
Nine CURE courses at 2000 or above level, of which at least two courses are from the Cultural Studies Areas[c] and at least seven courses are from the Religious Studies Areas

course_groups.label: Cultural Studies Area 1: Cultural Literacy and Practices
Cultural Studies Area 2: Culture, Cities and Politics
Cultural Studies Area 3: Gender, Sexuality and Body
Cultural Studies Area 4: Cultural Industries and Ecology
Cultural Studies Area 5: Film & Media Studies and Practices
Religious Studies Area 1: Approaches to Religious Studies
Religious Studies Area 2: Religious Traditions and Classics
Religious Studies Area 3: Religion, Culture and Society
Religious Studies Area 4: Classical Languages
Religious Studies Area 5: Seminars

text: 6 units of EDUC courses at 2000 and above level from Educational Core Component offered by the Faculty of Education
Four CURE courses at 2000 or above level from the Religious Studies Areas

course_groups.label: Religious Studies Area 1: Approaches to Religious Studies
Religious Studies Area 2: Religious Traditions and Classics
Religious Studies Area 3: Religion, Culture and Society
Religious Studies Area 4: Classical Languages
Religious Studies Area 5: Seminars

text: CURE2180 or ARAB1000, and CURE2181; OR
Three CURE courses at 2000 or above level from the Religious Studies Areas (except CURE2180 and 2181)

course_groups.label: Religious Studies Area 1: Approaches to Religious Studies
Religious Studies Area 2: Religious Traditions and Classics
Religious Studies Area 3: Religion, Culture and Society
Religious Studies Area 4: Classical Languages
Religious Studies Area 5: Seminars

text: Any five courses from ANTH4330, CURE2019, 2142, 2144, 2156, 2163, 3115, 3375, PSYC3720
Four CURE courses at 2000 or above level from the Religious Studies Areas

course_groups.label: Religious Studies Area 1: Approaches to Religious Studies
Religious Studies Area 2: Religious Traditions and Classics
Religious Studies Area 3: Religion, Culture and Society
Religious Studies Area 4: Classical Languages
Religious Studies Area 5: Seminars

notes.text: ANTH, ARAB, CURE, EDUC, PSYC and THEO courses at 2000 and above level (except those marked with *) as included in the respective concentrations will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification for students specialize in the relevant concentrations.
Courses counted towards the fulfillment of one of the above listed requirements cannot be used to fulfill concentration requirements.
Excluding the courses taken to fulfil requirement 1 and 2 above.

For students not specialising in any concentration, apart from the THEO courses listed in the course list, students may take other THEO courses, subject to a maximum of five THEO courses, as their elective courses to fulfill requirement 3(a).
For Cultural Studies Areas courses, please refer to the course list of Cultural Studies Programme.
Old course code used in 2024-25 and before.
